args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb. Same account, new name.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That title is out of date.
- Please check any PHL references in reports and digests, and use "Pellow Home Living" going forward.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia (via assistant)
